fields.name: Qadisha Valley Hiking
fields.description: Trek through the UNESCO-listed Qadisha Valley, one of the most dramatic gorges in Lebanon with ancient monasteries carved into cliffs.

fields.name: Cedars Ski Resort
fields.description: Ski on Lebanon's oldest ski resort surrounded by the ancient Cedars of God forest. Open December to April.

fields.name: Jeita Grotto Boat Ride
fields.description: Take a boat ride through the lower cave of Jeita Grotto, gliding along an underground river surrounded by stunning stalactites.

fields.name: Baalbek Temple Tour
fields.description: Guided tour of the Roman temples of Baalbek, including the Temple of Jupiter and Temple of Bacchus with expert local guides.

fields.name: Byblos Snorkeling
fields.description: Snorkel in the crystal-clear waters of Byblos along the ancient Phoenician coast, discovering underwater ruins and marine life.

fields.name: Beirut Nightlife Tour
fields.description: Experience Beirut's legendary nightlife with a guided tour of Gemmayzeh, Mar Mikhael and Downtown's best bars and clubs.

fields.name: Harissa Cable Car
fields.description: Take the famous cable car (teleferique) from Jounieh bay up to the Our Lady of Lebanon shrine in Harissa with panoramic views.

fields.name: Tyre Beach Day
fields.description: Relax on the stunning sandy beaches of Tyre, one of the best beaches in Lebanon near the UNESCO archaeological site.

fields.name: Shouf Cedar Reserve Hiking
fields.description: Hike through the Shouf Cedar Biosphere Reserve, the largest nature reserve in Lebanon with ancient cedar trees and wildlife.

fields.name: Sidon Soap Museum Tour
fields.description: Visit the famous Sidon Soap Museum housed in a 19th-century soap factory, exploring Lebanon's traditional soap-making heritage.
